summary: Describes a mechanism for signaling active or standby status of redundant pseudowires between their end points, so provider edge nodes agree on which one carries traffic. It applies to single-segment and multi-segment pseudowires.

eli5.summary: Two roads lead to the same place. This is how both ends agree which is the main road for today and which is the spare.

questions: what is the pseudowire preferential forwarding status bit
